newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices ease as crop arrivals rise.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices ease as crop arrivals rise.

text.p: Indian cotton prices eased on Wednesday as new crop arrivals rose and mill demand and overseas interest fell, dealers said.
New crop arrivals in the Punjab region was 28,000/30,000 bales (170 kg each) against an offtake of about 14,000/15,000 bales.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi fell by 10/25 rupees to 770/825 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned slid by 20 rupees to 1,390/1,610 rupees per maund.
Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) fell by 100 rupees to 11,500/11,700 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
